# opnsense_auth_group (Data Source)

Local groups (**System ▸ Access ▸ Groups**). Membership is managed on the user side with `opnsense_auth_user.group_memberships`; updating a group never changes its members.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `gid` (String) Group ID assigned by OPNsense; users refer to the group by this ID.
- `name` (String) Group name.
- `privileges` (Set of String) Privileges granted to members, e.g. `page-all` or `page-firewall-rules`.
